xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3123: Memory governor ignores swap entirely — swap can hit 0 free while it reports 'admitting', removing all OOM runway

plan.title: Memory governor: swap and PSI as first-class pressure inputs
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: assessMemoryPressure() in src/lib/cloister/memory-governor.ts decides purely on MemAvailable. Observed 2026-07-26: MemAvailable 28.98 GB with SwapFree 0.00 GB — the governor reported 'admitting' into a machine with zero swap runway, the state a prior run OOM-killed from. MemAvailable alone overstates headroom exactly when the machine cannot absorb a burst.
narratives.Proposal: Make swap and PSI first-class governor inputs. The snapshot already carries SwapFree/SwapTotal on both platforms; add PSI full/some avg10 from /proc/pressure/memory. Compose a swap verdict into the existing single-mode hysteresis: SwapFree below a soft percent of SwapTotal gates admission (holding — cheap, reversible); PSI full avg10 at/above threshold on top of low swap gates shedding (expensive, only when genuinely stalling). Re-admission requires both RAM >= RECOVERY and SwapFree >= swap-recovery percent. Swapless machines and PSI-unavailable platforms keep today's RAM-only behavior. All thresholds are new config-yaml keys with defaults 25% / 50% / 1.0.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to canAdmit, the footprint budget, or the HTTP spawn-path classifyMemoryPressure predicate.
- No swap-activity (pswpin/pswpout) rate gating — PSI full already captures the thrashing it indicates.
- No shedding on PSI alone while swap is healthy.
- No behavior change on swapless machines (SwapTotal = 0).
- No new dashboard surface for the verdict fields (additive data only).

autoDecisions.summary: Swap gates admission (holding), PSI gates shedding
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's 10:38Z issue comment explicitly refines the issue body's 'near zero => shedding': PSI full avg10 measured 0.00 while swap sat at ~99% used, so a swap-only shed rule would have shed healthy agents on an unstalled machine.

autoDecisions.summary: Swapless machines (SwapTotal = 0) are exempt from both runway gates
autoDecisions.rationale: A machine that never had swap elasticity must not suddenly hold forever — that would be a behavior change beyond this issue's scope.

autoDecisions.summary: PSI unavailable => no PSI shedding, swap gate still applies
autoDecisions.rationale: Non-Linux platforms and kernels without PSI return null; Darwin still reports swap via sysctl, so the swap rule remains meaningful there.

autoDecisions.summary: Runway composes into the existing single-mode hysteresis via a new exported nextGovernorModeWithRunway; nextGovernorMode and canAdmit keep their signatures and RAM-only semantics
autoDecisions.rationale: canAdmit is a pinned public shape and nextGovernorMode is covered by existing tests that must stay green; composition preserves the anti-oscillation guarantee without a second latch.

autoDecisions.summary: Defaults 25% swap-soft, 50% swap-recovery, PSI full shed threshold 1.0
autoDecisions.rationale: 25/50 matches the issue body's ~25% suggestion and gives a wide hysteresis band; 1.0 matches the existing LINUX_MEMORY_PRESSURE_DEFAULTS.fullCriticalAvg10 in src/lib/system-health/linux.ts:21.
The original defect was invisibility — operators could not see why the governor admitted. Additive fields, no consumer changes.

items.title: Add PSI avg10 fields to ProcMemorySnapshot

narrative.Action: Extend ProcMemorySnapshot (system-health-service.ts:66-74) with `psiSomeAvg10: number | null` and `psiFullAvg10: number | null`. Add an exported pure `parseMemoryPsi(content)` mirroring the regex semantics of parseMemoryPressure in src/lib/system-health/linux.ts:97-108 (match /^(some|full)\s+.*\bavg10=([^\s]+)/, Number(), reject non-finite or negative). readProcMemoryLinux (:327-345) reads /proc/pressure/memory inside its own try/catch (catch => both fields null, mirroring the Darwin vm_stat/sysctl pattern at :368/:378) and spreads the parsed values into the snapshot. readProcMemoryDarwin (:380-388) returns null for both. New test file covers: realistic two-line content parses both values; malformed lines and negative values are skipped; a missing `full` line yields fullAvg10 null while someAvg10 still parses; empty string yields both null. Full before/after snippets are in the PRD at drafts/pan-3123.md WI-1.

items.title: parseMemoryPsi('some avg10=1.23 avg60=0.40 avg300=0.10 total=12345\nfull avg10=0.05 avg60=0.01 avg300=0.00 total=678\n') returns { someAvg10: 1.23, fullAvg10: 0.05 }
ProcMemorySnapshot produces psiFullAvg10 null on Darwin and on an unreadable /proc/pressure/memory, while meminfo-derived fields still populate
The new vitest file passes and npm run typecheck completes without errors
Add governor swap/PSI threshold config keys with normalization

narrative.Action: Add three config keys: governor_swap_soft_free_percent (default 25), governor_swap_recovery_free_percent (default 50), governor_psi_full_shed_avg10 (default 1). Touch: schema.ts input block after governor_footprint_default_test_gb (:413) and the resolved resources type after governorFootprintDefaultTestGb (:888); defaults.ts after :212; merge.ts defaults spread near :185-189 plus per-key typeof overrides after the footprint-test override (:661-663). After the existing RECOVERY>SOFT normalization (merge.ts:665-668) add the swap analog: when governorSwapRecoveryFreePercent <= governorSwapSoftFreePercent, set it to min(soft + 10, 100) — normalize rather than throw, mirroring the GiB reserves. Tests in tests/lib/config-yaml.test.ts: defaults 25/50/1 when unset; explicit values round-trip; recovery <= soft normalizes to min(soft + 10, 100). Exact snippets in PRD WI-2.

merge accepts explicitly configured values and preserves them on the resolved resources, and defaults governor_swap_recovery_free_percent to min(soft + 10, 100) when configured <= the soft percent
tests/lib/config-yaml.test.ts passes and npm run typecheck completes without errors
Compose swap/PSI runway into the governor mode state machine

expected_outputs: memory-governor.test.ts passes including the FR-2 issue-acceptance case (healthy RAM + SwapFree 0 => not admitting)
typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: memory-verdict-cache.ts: add optional swapTotalBytes?, swapFreeBytes?, psiFullAvg10? to MemoryVerdict (additive). memory-governor.ts: export GovernorRunway { swapTotalBytes, swapFreeBytes, psiFullAvg10: number | null }, GovernorRunwayThresholds, and readGovernorRunwayThresholds() reading the three WI-2 resource values. Add the exported composer nextGovernorModeWithRunway(availableBytes, reserves, runway, runwayThresholds, previousMode): compute memMode via the UNCHANGED nextGovernorMode; return memMode untouched when runway.swapTotalBytes <= 0 (FR-5); otherwise swapSoftBytes = swapTotal * softPercent/100, swapRecoveryBytes = swapTotal * recoveryPercent/100, swapLow = (previousMode === 'admitting' ? swapFree < swapSoftBytes : swapFree < swapRecoveryBytes); psiShed = swapLow && psiFullAvg10 != null && psiFullAvg10 >= threshold; return 'shedding' when memMode === 'shedding' || psiShed, 'holding' when swapLow, else memMode. Leave nextGovernorMode (:90-101) and canAdmit (:185-187) byte-identical (NFR-1/NFR-2). assessMemoryPressure() (:116-127) calls the composer with the snapshot's swap/PSI fields and populates the three new verdict fields. Update the test file's readProcMemory/loadConfigSync mocks to carry swap/PSI and the new config keys (H2 in continue.json). New named tests: (a) FR-2 issue AC — RAM above RECOVERY, SwapTotal 8 GiB, SwapFree 0, psi 0 => band != ok (holding); (b) FR-3 swap hysteresis — held, SwapFree between soft and recovery stays holding, above recovery admits; (c) FR-4 — RAM healthy, SwapFree below soft, psiFullAvg10 = 1 => shedding; (d) FR-6 — same with psiFullAvg10 null => holding; (e) FR-5 — SwapTotal 0 => admitting, RAM-only behavior; (g) FR-8 — verdict carries the snapshot's swap/PSI fields. The existing nextGovernorMode block must pass unmodified. Full composer source in PRD WI-3.

items.title: With memAvailable above RECOVERY and SwapFree 0 of an 8 GiB SwapTotal, assessMemoryPressure() returns a non-'ok' verdict (holding/soft) — the issue's acceptance criterion, failing on pre-change code
Once held for low swap, the governor re-admits only when SwapFree reaches the swap-recovery percent of SwapTotal and RAM >= RECOVERY; SwapFree between soft and recovery preserves holding
RAM healthy + SwapFree below the soft percent + psiFullAvg10 >= threshold produces shedding; the same inputs with psiFullAvg10 null produce holding instead
SwapTotal 0 produces verdicts identical to RAM-only behavior, and the pre-existing nextGovernorMode and canAdmit tests pass unmodified
assessMemoryPressure() returns a MemoryVerdict that contains swapTotalBytes, swapFreeBytes, and psiFullAvg10 populated from the snapshot

expected_outputs: each grep prints matching lines in the model section and config table
